aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food trucks and mobile refreshment businesses: online orders, collection times and fewer repetitive questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food trucks and mobile refreshment businesses, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing smoothly and spend less time dealing with repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet much of the software available to them is designed around businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our focus is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses actually operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab started with a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their businesses.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory helping people discover food trucks visiting their local area, I spent more time learning about the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are constantly moving, working at different locations and serving customers in changing conditions.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a later date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break sales down by period, item and event and find out what is really selling.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you do not have to confirm each one separately.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you give a customer a buzzer, assign its number to the order, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows order numbers and when they are ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so customers nearby can find you.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show upcoming dates on your website. Each one leads straight to its order page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and also the only way to take orders even when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards — stamps are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into meal deals and offer add-ons when ordering, to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: The same as auto-replies for WhatsApp, just for questions via Messenger and Instagram.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the hatch window and in the kitchen — and you see the same current orders on all of them.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give staff their own login details with the right level of access.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers cannot place orders you would not see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you take orders offline too; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment up front when customers order online — via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that do not show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm it.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we add the dates, places and times for each week and each event automatically.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a number of pieces and it counts down as orders come in, until the item sells out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you do not need a separate card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot for collection, so demand is spread across the whole service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders at the hatch window, with payment on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatic replies to WhatsApp questions about your menu and schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can prepare at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: On the phone in your apron pocket, on the tablet on the counter, on the laptop in the food truck — and on the card terminal you already take payments on.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You are somewhere else every week, at different times, with weak or no mobile signal. HatchGrab was made for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically so customers cannot place orders you would not see. Keep taking orders in the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We fill in your dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Shorter queues and food ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Built for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Messages via WhatsApp get answered while you are driving to your pitch or standing at the grill — based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
